product_summary: Website silverlinechemicals.com (accessed via http_get) lists a very broad catalogue under headings: Mint Products (menthol crystals, dementholised peppermint oil, levomenthol, racemic menthol, menthol powder), Essential Oils (~100 items: peppermint, spearmint, mentha arvensis/citrata, eucalyptus, lemongrass, citronella, clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, cardamom, vetiver, patchouli, ylang-ylang, carrier oils), Aromatic Chemicals (benzyl benzoate, linalool, geraniol, citronellol, linalyl/geranyl/citronellyl/menthyl/isobornyl acetates, benzaldehyde, cinnamic aldehyde, eugenol, isoeugenol, methyl eugenol, limonene, pinene, ionones, damascones, rose oxide, eucalyptol, anethole, terpineol, thymol, carvacrol, camphor, methyl salicylate), Oleoresins (paprika, capsicum, turmeric, curcumin, black pepper, ginger, cumin, coriander, garlic, onion, fenugreek, mace, nutmeg, cardamom, vanilla, tamarind, rosemary, basil, celery, cassia, star anise, etc., incl. water-soluble grades), Pharmaceutical Ingredients/Raw Materials (sorbitol solution 70% BP/USP, microcrystalline cellulose, croscarmellose sodium, sodium starch glycolate, magnesium/calcium/zinc stearate, povidone iodine, colloidal silicon dioxide, maize starch, dextrose anhydrous, beeswax, benzyl alcohol, thymol, BHT, BHA, sodium nitrate, potassium iodate, sodium iodide, zinc oxide, bromelain, chlorhexidine gluconate, sodium picosulfate, nicotine, and APIs: sildenafil citrate, tadalafil, meloxicam, piroxicam, prilocaine, paracetamol, bromhexine HCl). Declared codes 2905.44 (sorbitol), 2906.11 (menthol) and 3912.90 (cellulose derivatives) are all genuinely present in the catalogue, so the declaration is not wrong — but it covers only 3 of at least 15-20 HS headings the catalogue actually spans.
comment: Match: PARTIAL. All three declared codes are corroborated by real catalogue lines: 2905.44 = Sorbitol Solution 70% BP/USP (crystalline and non-crystalline grade); 2906.11 = Natural/Racemic Menthol Crystals, Levomenthol, Menthol Powder; 3912.90 = Microcrystalline cellulose, Croscarmellose sodium, Sodium starch glycolate, Filter aid cellulose, Cellulose welding grade. However the declared 3 codes describe only a small slice of the business: the site is a multi-line chemicals/essential-oils/oleoresins/pharma-excipients catalogue spanning roughly 2902, 2905, 2906, 2907, 2909, 2912, 2914, 2915, 2916, 2918, 2933/2934, 2942, 3301, 3302, 1302, 3203, 1515, 1521, 1702, 2811, 2817, 2827, 2834, 3808, 3824, 3905 and 3912. Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only partly right — the oleoresins, essential oils and sorbitol/dextrose/starch lines are food/FMCG-adjacent, but the bulk of the catalogue is industrial aromatic chemicals, pharmaceutical excipients and APIs (incl. sildenafil citrate, tadalafil, paracetamol, nicotine), which is chemicals/pharma, not FMCG. Trader signs: the catalogue mixes products from clearly unrelated manufacturing chains (mint processing, spice oleoresins, synthetic aroma chemicals, pharma APIs, cellulose excipients, beeswax, castor oil) with no plant or capacity information on the pages retrieved; the site presents itself as 'manufacturers' of everything, which is a classic multi-line trading/indenting pattern. Role assessed as trader (or manufacturer_trader at most) — cannot be confirmed from public pages. Product lines missing from the declaration: essential oils (3301), oleoresins and vegetable extracts (1302/3203), aroma chemicals (2902/2907/2909/2912/2914/2916), pharma excipients and APIs (2933/2934/2942/3905), stearates, zinc oxide, iodides, beeswax, dextrose/starch. All of the above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (per role scope), so no product is confirmed as actually shipped. Note on code precision: thymol/carvacrol/eugenol are phenols (2907.1x) rather than 2906; methyl salicylate is 2918.23; camphor is 2914.2x; metal stearates are not 2915 — these are the codes to use if the declaration is expanded. No rejection on HS grounds: company retained, codes to be corrected/expanded to the actual product mix.
